description: This file defines the 'HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Forms' class, which implements a module handling HTML forms elements in the HTML Purifier library. It includes setup procedures for defining form-related HTML elements such as <form>, <input>, <select>, <textarea>, and others, with their attributes and characteristics.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Forms
classes.description: Class representing the forms module in the HTML Purifier library, defining form elements and their attributes.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the module by adding various form-related elements and configuring their attributes and behaviors based on the provided configuration.
